title: Austin Growth: Schools, Roads, & Zoning
summary:
*   Voters approved a substantial $750,000 bond for constructing and improving public school buildings and equipment.
*   A major update to the city's zoning ordinance was passed. Public hearings also led to specific rezonings for commercial use, notably involving an agreement with a wood yard owner to clear his property in exchange for a zoning change.
*   Funds were allocated for widening West 8th and Colorado Streets. A permit was also granted for the Texas Public Service Company to lay new gas mains across numerous city streets.
*   City leaders discussed applying for federal Public Works Administration (PWA) grants and approved funds to adjust parking meters to a precise 30-degree angle with the curb.

REGULAR MEETING OF THE CITY COUNCIL:
